description: GET /v1/merchants/me/paymaster/overview - aggregate sponsorship stats for this merchant: totals (ops, successes, reverts, gas cost, sponsored vs denied attempts) plus a per-chain breakdown, lifetime and inside the selected window. Testnet chains are flagged isTestnet: metered but never billed. On-chain figures (totalOps, successCount, revertCount, gas cost) cover settled ops attributed to this merchant for EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8. The sponsoredOps / deniedOps counters count recorded attempts for both versions; denied_chain, denied_entrypoint, denied_origin and denied_malformed are sampled (at most 20 rows per client and status per 10 minutes per API instance). These aggregates avoid pagination loss but cannot recover unrecorded denials. The separate settled on-chain figures are not subject to this attempt-recording cap. Read-only.

window.description: Default 24h. Windowed figures are the window* fields; the others are lifetime.
